package.name: golfcart_domain_bridge
package.description: Copies a fixed list of topics between the host's internal ROS domain (0, bound to lo) and the master/orin link domain (bound to the LAN interface). One process per host; the only participant either host puts on the wire. Type-agnostic: serialized bytes in, serialized bytes out, with per-topic QoS and an optional rate cap.
